primary_input_contract.canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON; sort_keys=true; separators=(',', ':'); no whitespace; booleans lowercase

goal_class.definition: The operation the request asks to perform, classified from request semantics without reference to any capability identity.

has_scope.definition: True only when the request or independently frozen case metadata supplies a valid scope identifier required by the requested operation.

has_version.definition: True only when the request or independently frozen case metadata supplies a valid version identifier required by the requested operation.

asks_write.definition: True when the requested operation would modify persistent or protected state; false for read-only, explanatory, or clarification operations.

requires_strict_policy.definition: True only when a claim-resolution request explicitly requires strict four-state epistemic handling, conflict preservation, or an auditable policy trace; this feature describes an output obligation, not an implementation choice.
requires_strict_policy.applicability: claim_resolution_only; ignored by the routing policy for other goal classes
